name: cat_push_key2
desc: keep the same little black witch cat, same face with eyes shut tight as thin lines, mouth very slightly open, one small tear, same hat, cape, colors and size, legs and feet exactly where they are. Its arms do not stretch out: elbows stay bent and close to its body, and both small paws are pressed flat against something huge and soft right beside its left shoulder at chest height, the paws sinking a little into sticky pink goo with short goo strings stretching from them. Its body leans slightly away to the right and its head turns slightly away, straining. Subtle cute face, not exaggerated.
